cfg_universe: Four constituents, none substituted for another: (1) typed code/thunk extent entries plus decoded target-root island records, closed over direct branch/jump/call edges and the post-call fall-through; (2) the hash-verified phase3 jr-table targets recorded in indirect_jump_targets; (3) the gate-only jr target sets imported under indirect_jump_targets_from_gate, with phase3_sites_not_in_gate measured, not assumed; (4) target-root code islands decoded from proved jr targets landing in unclaimed bytes, each a census record with its own stopping proof. This is NOT the static-ASM gate's algorithm or universe: the gate itself reports indirect_edges_followed: false and follows direct edges only.
